scores.tell: Books have a slightly soft, blurry painterly edge and a hazy background. Edges are less crisp than on the real cards.
Clean, crisp edges with no outline. Stitching and the tooled leather give dense but controlled interior edges. Close to the grade-5 saddle.
Soft, rounded edges with no outline. The keys have clean seams. The calculator edge is a touch heavy.
The edge density of the grass tufts and the checkerboard is high. The table edges are fine, but the busy small marks are more textured than the real cards.
Many small crater and pebble edges across the whole background. The dome ribs are crisp. The background is as busy as the subject.
Smooth, soft contours with no outline. The buckle edge is clean. The background rings are soft.
Dense small edges in the foliage and bark. The pot has dark speckled soot and dirty edge noise. The background is as busy as the subject.
Clean soft edges. The trunk ring lines are slightly dark and the frond cut lines are a bit sharp.
Soft clean edges overall. The faint cracks in the floor and a darker rim contour add slight linework.
Thin, precise tube edges and crisp stitching. The chair legs have slightly hard, bright edges. There are no outlines.
